capabilities: Import Douyin share links or share text into the vault
Download no-watermark videos and carousel images locally
Transcribe video audio to Simplified Chinese with a local Whisper backend
Generate notes with frontmatter, hashtag callouts, and embedded media
Run imports from a ribbon modal or command palette commands
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.4.0+, no mobile). All processing is local; no Douyin cookie or paid speech API needed, but the local Python backend must be running before import works. MIT licensed with a disclaimer to use only for personal learning and research; no OCR for text embedded in images.
intentEvidence: This project is forked from lyxdream/obsidian-douyin-capture
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Douyin share link into a note containing the video, carousel images, caption text, and metadata.

relations.evidence: This project is forked from lyxdream/obsidian-douyin-capture
This plugin depends on the local Python service obsidian-content-capture-backend

summary: Imports Douyin share links into the vault as structured notes with locally downloaded no-watermark videos, images, captions, and optional Whisper transcription.
